title: Nell Waits Out the Storm
checkpoint: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 continues (School readiness) — new alternative pronunciations i as igh, o as oa, o as u, u as oo.

pages.text: Dark clouds sit on top of the garden.
pages.illustration: Heavy dark grey clouds looming over a garden, the light dimming.

pages.text: Nell spots a little roof on a post.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying toward a wooden bird table with a little sloped roof on a post.
Nell the bee tucked under the small overhanging roof, sheltered from above.

pages.text: Wind rocks the post bit by bit.
pages.illustration: The wooden post swaying gently side to side in strong wind.
Nell the bee gripping tightly onto the wooden post with her little legs.

pages.text: Rain taps hard on the roof.
pages.illustration: Heavy rain splashing and bouncing off the sloped wooden roof above Nell.
Nell the bee calm and dry in her sheltered spot, rain falling just beyond the roof edge.

pages.text: Bit by bit, the storm fades.
pages.illustration: The dark clouds thinning, light returning to the garden around the post.

pages.text: The sun is out at last.
pages.illustration: Bright sunlight breaking through the clouds over the little roof.

pages.text: Nell flies off into the sun.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee flying out from under the roof into warm, bright sunlight.
